title: Backpedal and Balance Recovery
description: Players sprint forward, backpedal under control, and recover into a balanced defensive stance — the transition moment most footwork drills skip.

content.objective: Transition smoothly from a forward sprint to a controlled backpedal and a balanced stance.
content.setup: Players line up at the wing with open space to sprint toward the top of the key.
instructions: Sprint forward for three steps on the coach's signal.
Immediately backpedal under control for three steps on the next signal.
Drop into a low, balanced defensive stance on the final whistle.
Repeat with randomised timing so the transition stays reactive.
coachingPoints: Keep the body low through the whole transition, not just at the stance.
Use short, quick steps when backpedaling, not long strides.
Land the final stance with the feet already shoulder-width apart.
commonMistakes: Standing up tall right before dropping into the stance.
Overstriding during the backpedal, which slows the recovery.
Letting the feet settle flat instead of staying on the balls of the feet.
content.safety: Check the backpedal path is completely clear before starting.
